content:
Clara Ruiz: :loudspeaker: Quick heads-up — today we're making a small org adjustment in Serving to reduce handoffs between Dedicated and Private infra teams. Summary below, town hall at 3pm PT.

Clara Ruiz: What changes: we're consolidating two small serving squads (Edge Serving + Dedicated Ops) into a single 'Serving Squads' group under Amir Patel for 90-day execution. Goal: fewer cross-team runbooks, unified rollout policy for model variants.

Clara Ruiz: Why now: repeated latency incident handoffs and duplicated oncall rotations. This is scoped to runtime operational ownership only — product, model-onboarding, and SRE reporting lines unchanged.

Amir Patel: Happy to lead this. I'll be focusing on operational playbooks, SLA templates, and a short roadmap for the 90-day window. Please ping me with pain points.

Sasha Lee: I'll act as interim lead for Model Onboarding during the transition (2 months). I'll keep my backlog triaged but hand over owner of the Dedicated GPU scheduling to Amir.

Diego Morales: Quick question — any immediate changes to oncall rota or escalation paths? We need to update our ops runbook if so.

Clara Ruiz: Good call, Diego. Oncall stays the same this week. Amir and Sasha will publish the new escalation doc by EOD Friday; we'll attach it to the incident runbook and the oncall calendar.

Priya Natarajan: How will this impact current Dedicated customers? Need to coordinate with Sales/CS re: any SLA language changes.

Amir Patel: No outward SLA changes planned — this is internal routing. If anything shifts, I'll coordinate with Sales and CS and loop in Priya for comms.

people-ops-bot: Meeting: Serving Squads transition town hall scheduled by Clara Ruiz — 3:00 PM PT today in All Hands room. Invite sent to attendees.

Evan Carter: Thanks Clara & Amir. Two asks: (1) can we freeze any noncritical infra deployments during the first 48 hours after the change? (2) can we get a short list of owners for each subdomain (routing, cache, batching)?

Clara Ruiz: Evan — yes to (1), will request a 48-hr soft freeze on infra changes from Eng Infra. (2) Amir will post owners list in #eng-runtime and attach to the town hall notes.

Diego Morales: Noted. I'll adjust the runbook once Amir posts owners and will coordinate a quick sync with Ops SRE tomorrow morning.

Amir Patel: Owners list draft (to be published): routing -> Sasha Lee; cache -> Diego Morales; batching -> Evan Carter; deployment orchestration -> Amir Patel. Will refine during the town hall.

Priya Natarajan: Thanks — once owners are confirmed, I'll prep a short customer-facing FAQ in case Sales gets questions.

Clara Ruiz: Action items: Amir & Sasha publish escalation doc by Friday; Amir publish owners list pre-town hall; 48-hr soft freeze on infra changes; Priya to prep customer FAQ if needed. Town hall in 2 hours — bring questions. :calendar:

Amir Patel: Appreciate the trust. Looking forward to tightening the handoffs.

Sasha Lee: Will share my interim handoff notes after the town hall.

people-ops-bot: Channel reminder: please react with :eyes: if you'll attend the 3pm PT town hall.
